test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In April 2023, Tamil Nadu passed a bill banning which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is **Online Gambling**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Tamil Nadu government passed a bill in April 2023 to **ban online gambling** within the state.
 
• This move was aimed at **protecting people** from the harms associated with gambling, including financial loss and addiction.
 
• The ban includes various forms of online betting and games that involve monetary transactions.
 
• This legislation reflects a growing concern over the **impact of online gambling** on society, especially among the youth.
 
• Similar actions to regulate or ban online gambling have been taken by other states in India, highlighting a national concern over the issue.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Online gambling** refers to any kind of gambling activity conducted on the internet, including casinos, sports betting, and lotteries.
 
• It has seen a global surge in popularity, attributed to technological advancements and increased internet access.
 
• Concerns about online gambling include issues related to **addiction, financial instability**, and the potential for **fraudulent activities**.
 
• Various countries have distinct regulations regarding online gambling, ranging from complete bans to comprehensive legal frameworks that allow it under specific conditions.
 
• In India, gambling laws are primarily state-governed, leading to a diverse regulatory landscape across the country.
